name: feature_instance_class_id

ownership.argument: Consequence for the module: the Feature instance class id is NOT a compile-time constant on this build, so a p67 module must not hardcode one; it has to read this global after the runtime has initialised.

provenance.source: Global holding the JS class id assigned at runtime to the Feature instance class. ensureJsClass 0xC867040 obtains it with the QuickJS class-id allocator 0xC2780F4(&dword_2013CE38) and registers the class through 0xC278140(ctx, id, &classdef at 0x200E7EA8); every JS_GetOpaque in the feature framework unwraps with this id, e.g. event_set 0xC8697FC and method_call 0xC86C2B8.

notes: Consequence for the module: the Feature instance class id is NOT a compile-time constant on this build, so a p67 module must not hardcode one; it has to read this global after the runtime has initialised.
